pages.title: Flows
pages._note: ADR-110 Decision 4: a flow is app-specific, so the authoring surface lives here rather than behind a deep link to another app's list. An ordinary index over the named `flows` source (config.entitySource) rather than the deprecated `flows` page type, reading OpenRegister's one native flow store (ADR-065), scoped to this app by config.app. rowRoute names the FlowDetail page (a route name, not a path): a named-source page has no register and schema, so without it a row click opens nothing and Edit falls back to the source's own /flows path.

pages.title: Flow
pages._note: The shared CnFlowDetail canvas over the same single engine. Controls render in the NC app sidebar (sidebarComponent) so the canvas keeps full width; canvas and sidebar share useFlowStore. The _note claimed this before the field existed, so #/flows/new -- and every #/flows/:id -- rendered a bare canvas with no way to name, describe, trigger or step-edit the flow. Mirrors pipelinq#1490.
